title: Raku Firing - Monthly Session
source_quote: If it's the 3rd Mon of the month, it must be raku day at Casa de Norris. And we had a brief and spectacular firing session and the our outcomes were amazing. ... So much fun and we'll be doing it again in Oct!
evidence_sentence: Instagram post states raku firings happen on the 3rd Monday of each month, with the next one scheduled for October.
